mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.conversation_type, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM im_conversation c INNER JOIN im_conversation_member m ON m.conversation_id = c.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT c.conversation_type AS conversationType, (SELECT m.user_id FROM im_conversation_member m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}) AS memberUserId, (SELECT um.muted_until FROM im_user_mute um WHERE um.user_id = #{userId}) AS mutedUntil, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 1 THEN (SELECT m2.user_id FROM im_conversation_member m2 WHERE m2.conversation_id = c.id AND m2.user_id <> #{userId} LIMIT 1) END AS peerUserId, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 1 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM im_blacklist b WHERE b.user_id = (SELECT m3.user_id FROM im_conversation_member m3 WHERE m3.conversation_id = c.id AND m3.user_id <> #{userId} LIMIT 1) AND b.blocked_user_id = #{userId}) END AS peerBlocked FROM im_conversation c WHERE c.id = #{conversationId}

SELECT c.id AS conversationId, c.conversation_type AS conversationType, c.updated_at AS updatedAt, me.last_read_seq AS lastReadSeq, me.cleared_seq AS clearedSeq, me.manual_unread AS manualUnread, me.pinned AS pinned, me.muted AS muted, CASE WHEN me.hidden_at IS NOT NULL AND (lm.created_at IS NULL OR lm.created_at <= me.hidden_at) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hidden, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(mx.seq) FROM im_message mx WHERE mx.conversation_id = c.id), 0) AS lastSeq, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM im_conversation_member cnt WHERE cnt.conversation_id = c.id) AS memberCount, lm.msg_type AS lastMessageType, LEFT(lm.content, 1024) AS lastMessageContent, lm.recalled_at AS lastMessageRecalledAt, lm.created_at AS lastMessageCreatedAt, g.name AS groupName, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 1 THEN (SELECT p.user_id FROM im_conversation_member p WHERE p.conversation_id = c.id AND p.user_id <> #{userId} LIMIT 1) END AS peerUserId, CASE WHEN c.conversation_type = 1 THEN (SELECT u.nickname FROM im_user u WHERE u.id = (SELECT p2.user_id FROM im_conversation_member p2 WHERE p2.conversation_id = c.id AND p2.user_id <> #{userId} LIMIT 1)) END AS peerNickname FROM im_conversation c INNER JOIN im_conversation_member me ON me.conversation_id = c.id AND me.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN im_message lm ON lm.conversation_id = c.id AND lm.seq = (SELECT MAX(m2.seq) FROM im_message m2 WHERE m2.conversation_id = c.id AND m2.seq > me.cleared_seq) LEFT JOIN im_group g ON g.id = c.id ORDER BY COALESCE(lm.created_at, c.updated_at) DESC LIMIT 200
